definitions.short: Elkanah , the name of several Israelites
definitions.full: H511. Elqanah אֶלְקָנָה proper name, masculine ( God has created , or taken possession ) a. father of Samuel 1 Samuel 1-2 (8 t.) 1Chr 6:12 ; 6:19 . b. son of Korah Exod 6:24 . c. a ruler in Jerusalem in the time of Ahaz 2Chr 28:7 . d. one of David's warriors 1Chr 12:6 . e. several Levites ( a ) 1Chr 6:8 ; 6:10 ; 6:21 . ( β ) v. 6:11 ; v. 6:20 . ( γ ) 9:16 ( δ ) 15:23 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions;
Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.
The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.”
Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.
Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May Yahweh give you offspring† or, seed from this woman for the petition which was asked of Yahweh.” Then they went to their own home.
Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
